$comment: Beckhoff ADS extension configuration schema. See https://docs.zeloscloud.io/sdk/how-to/develop-extensions/#configuration
title: Beckhoff ADS Configuration
description: Configure TwinCAT targets and how their PLC variables are traced

targets.title: Targets
targets.description: TwinCAT runtimes to trace. Click 'Add' to add one, or use Auto-configure to find TwinCAT routers on this machine and its network (UDP broadcast) and fill in their AMS NetIds.

name.title: Name
name.description: Label this target appears under in the trace and the `target` parameter of the actions. Defaults to the host (e.g. plc1, 192_168_1_10); sanitized like field names.

host.title: Host
host.description: IP address or host name of the TwinCAT router; `localhost` for the TwinCAT this agent runs on.

ams_net_id.title: AMS NetId
ams_net_id.description: The target's AMS NetId (e.g. 5.1.2.3.1.1). Leave empty to ask the router at Host for it on every connect (UDP 48899).
ams_net_id.ui:placeholder: asked from the host when empty

port.title: AMS Port
port.description: The PLC runtime: 851 for the first TwinCAT 3 PLC, 852 for the second, 801 for TwinCAT 2.

symbol_map_file.title: Symbol Map File
symbol_map_file.description: JSON map of the symbols to trace, grouped into events. Leave empty to trace every scalar PLC variable the target holds (see Advanced > Include / Exclude).
symbol_map_file.ui:help: JSON file grouping PLC symbols into named events

cycle_time.title: Cycle Time (ms)
cycle_time.description: How often the target checks subscribed symbols for a change (notification transport), or the poll period (poll transport).

include.title: Include
include.description: Without a symbol map: symbol globs to trace (`*` one segment, `**` any depth), e.g. MAIN.** or GVL_IO.*. Empty uses Advanced > Include.

exclude.title: Exclude
exclude.description: Without a symbol map: symbol globs not traced, e.g. **.bDebug. Wins over include. Empty uses Advanced > Exclude.

advanced.title: Advanced
advanced.description: Settings shared by every target, and the defaults a target inherits.

prefix.title: Prefix
prefix.description: Leading trace source every target publishes under, so events read '<prefix>/<target>/<POU>'. Clear it to give each target its own trace source with unprefixed events.

local_ams_net_id.title: Local AMS NetId
local_ams_net_id.description: The one AMS NetId this extension presents to every target, on a machine without a TwinCAT router (Linux, macOS). Empty derives it from this machine's IP toward the first target plus `.1.1`; set it when the targets sit on different interfaces. Every target must hold a route for it (Add Route action, or TwinCAT XAE). Ignored where TwinCAT's own router runs (Beckhoff devices, Windows with TwinCAT).

transport.title: Transport
transport.description: 'notification': the target pushes value changes (ADS device notifications, one per symbol), checked every cycle time. 'poll': one sum read of every symbol per cycle time. A target with more symbols than Max Notifications polls.

max_notifications.title: Max Notifications
max_notifications.description: Symbols per target above which the notification transport falls back to polling, with one warning.

min_update_interval.title: Min Update Interval (seconds)
min_update_interval.description: With notifications, a symbol that reports no change for this long is re-read and logged at the read time.

include.title: Include
include.description: Without a symbol map: symbol globs to trace, over the dotted symbol path (`*` within one segment, `**` any depth), e.g. MAIN.**. Empty traces every PLC variable except TwinCAT's own (TwinCAT_*, Constants, Global_Version, LREAL_CONST), which an include may name.

exclude.title: Exclude
exclude.description: Without a symbol map: symbol globs not traced, e.g. GVL_Debug.** or **.bSimulate. Wins over include.
